about: Realizability description of the tool-call monitor. Inputs are everything the attacker or the environment decides, outputs are what the monitor decides. The FUN requirements demand that allowed calls really happen, so that a monitor which does nothing is not a solution; the CM requirements are the security lines of requirements/call_requirements.json in a form with inputs. The mutants state the original behaviour and must make the set unrealizable.

plan_sens: the plan of the turn asks for a sensitive read
ver_sens: the verifier confirmed a sensitive read (it may add tools the plan never asked for)
pol_sens: the policy allows a sensitive read
req_sens: the model asks the gate for a sensitive read
issued_sens: the ticket grants a sensitive read
plan_send: the plan of the turn asks for an external send
ver_send: the verifier confirmed an external send (it may add tools the plan never asked for)
pol_send: the policy allows an external send
req_send: the model asks the gate for an external send
issued_send: the ticket grants an external send
plan_other: the plan of the turn asks for another tool
ver_other: the verifier confirmed another tool (it may add tools the plan never asked for)
req_other: the model asks the gate for another tool
ticket_ok: the turn has a valid, unexpired ticket
sens_ran_before: a sensitive read has executed earlier in the session
llm_requested: a stage wants to call the model
llm_at_cap: the turn has used up its model-call budget
llm_done: the call reaches the model provider
claims_complete: the evaluator model claims the work is complete
plan_needs_tool: the plan asked for at least one tool
ok_before: a tool call of this turn has already succeeded
completed: the turn is accepted as completed

requirements.text: Monitor shall always satisfy ((ver_sens & pol_sens & plan_sens) => issued_sens)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((ver_send & pol_send & plan_send) => issued_send)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((ver_other & pol_other & plan_other) => issued_other)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((req_sens & ticket_ok & issued_sens) => exec_sens)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((req_other & ticket_ok & issued_other) => exec_other)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((req_send & ticket_ok & issued_send & !sens_ran_before) => exec_send)
Monitor shall always satisfy ((completed & plan_needs_tool) => ok_before)

mutants.desc: original-style defect: a call runs without a valid ticket

mutants.text: Monitor shall always satisfy ((ver_send & pol_send & !plan_send) => issued_send)
mutants.desc: original behaviour: the verifier's extra tool is granted

mutants.text: Monitor shall always satisfy ((req_send & ticket_ok & issued_send & sens_ran_before) => exec_send)
mutants.desc: original behaviour: a send runs after a sensitive read

mutants.text: Monitor shall always satisfy ((llm_requested & llm_at_cap) => llm_done)
mutants.desc: original behaviour: the model is called over the budget

mutants.text: Monitor shall always satisfy ((claims_complete & plan_needs_tool & !ok_before) => completed)
mutants.desc: original behaviour: the claim alone completes the turn
